intent: Writes the IaC design record: the landing-zone foundation, elicited environments (no baked ladder — it always asks), well-architected pillars, a per-environment region strategy, keyless OIDC identity, and the protected resources.

dimensions.name: landing-zone-elicited-envs
dimensions.criterion: Designs the landing-zone foundation and elicits the environments rather than baking a fixed ladder.

dimensions.name: well-architected-pillars
dimensions.criterion: Plans the well-architected pillars with a per-environment region strategy.

dimensions.name: keyless-and-protected
dimensions.criterion: Uses keyless OIDC identity (never a downloadable key) and records the protected resources.
